result.summary: All 11 validation checks PASS. Design artefact for ISS-0174 / GH-502 is complete, correct, and unambiguous. Decision RETAIN is recorded in four sections. Five substitution rules (S1-S5) are token-anchored and verified against Zig 0.16 unmanaged ArrayList API contracts. Longjmp-unsafe contract mirrors writeGrants doc comment style at host_context.zig:359. Test specification (TC-CS-01..05) is concrete with explicit expected outputs and allocator/ownership assertions. Build wiring is unambiguous: new test block appended after ISS-0153 block in src/lua_test_root.zig. Deliberate-mutation procedure is concrete (inject const _bad: u32 = 'definitely not a u32'; after defer buf.deinit(allocator);; run zig build test-lua; expect red; revert; expect green). SHOULD-1 and SHOULD-2 deferred to follow-up runs with explicit status. Regression risk bounded (signature unchanged, zero existing callers, new sort contract is a strict improvement over the previous unspecified HashMap iteration order). One MINOR caveat noted: the illustrative BEFORE/AFTER line numbers in design section 1 do not match the live source file (off by 11 lines); the S1-S5 rule table is the authoritative source and is correct. BACKEND-DEV should apply S1-S5 by token, not by line number.
